source: 上外版必修第二册 Unit 4 词表(真词;△超纲与专名跳过);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、运动主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.meaning_cn: 终极的;最好的;最重要的
words.example_en: Winning the title was the ultimate dream of every player on the team.
words.example_cn: 夺冠是队里每名球员的终极梦想。

words.meaning_cn: 艰难的;棘手的;坚韧的;能吃苦的
words.example_en: Their next opponent is a tough team that never gives up.
words.example_cn: 他们的下一个对手是一支永不放弃的强队。

words.example_en: Every competitor in the race wanted to reach the line first.
words.example_cn: 比赛中每个选手都想第一个冲过终点线。

words.example_en: Millions of people watched the final match on television.
words.example_cn: 数百万人在电视上观看了那场决赛。

words.example_en: Beckham could bend the ball around the wall and into the net.
words.example_cn: 贝克汉姆能让球绕过人墙弯进球网。

words.example_en: She hit the ball hard, and it flew straight into the net.
words.example_cn: 她用力一射,球径直飞进了球网。

words.example_en: He scored the winning goal in the last minute of the game.
words.example_cn: 他在比赛最后一分钟攻入了制胜进球。

words.example_en: When the final whistle blew, the players felt great relief.
words.example_cn: 终场哨声响起时,球员们感到极大的宽慰。

words.example_en: The whole team began to scream with joy after the goal.
words.example_cn: 进球之后全队都开始欢呼尖叫。

words.example_en: The match ended in a draw, so the teams went to penalties.
words.example_cn: 比赛打成平局,两队便进入点球大战。

words.example_en: Before the season, the two clubs played a friendly for practice.
words.example_cn: 赛季之前,两家俱乐部踢了一场友谊赛练兵。

words.example_en: She rolled the ball smoothly into the corner of the net.
words.example_cn: 她把球平稳地滚进了球网的角落。

words.example_en: She took a deep breath before stepping up to take the penalty.
words.example_cn: 上前主罚点球前,她深吸了一口气。

words.example_en: He tried to calm himself down before the most important shot.
words.example_cn: 在最关键的一射之前,他努力让自己镇定下来。

words.example_en: A loud roar around the stadium told her that the goal had gone in.
words.example_cn: 体育场里一声巨大的轰鸣告诉她进球了。

words.example_en: Thousands of fans filled the stadium to watch the big match.
words.example_cn: 成千上万的球迷涌入体育场观看这场大赛。

words.example_en: He placed the ball on the spot and looked up at the goal.
words.example_cn: 他把球放在点球点上,抬头望向球门。

words.example_en: By the end of the game she was incredibly tired but very happy.
words.example_cn: 比赛结束时她累极了,却非常开心。

words.example_en: The ball hit the crossbar and bounced away into the crowd.
words.example_cn: 球打在横梁上,弹开飞进了人群。

words.example_en: A huge crowd cheered loudly when the home team scored.
words.example_cn: 主队进球时,一大群观众大声欢呼。

words.example_en: In wushu, the judges give points for each athlete's movements.
words.example_cn: 在武术比赛中,裁判为每位选手的动作打分。

words.example_en: Young fans admire the players who train hard and never give up.
words.example_cn: 年轻球迷仰慕那些刻苦训练、永不放弃的球员。

words.example_en: He has to be realistic about how far he can go in the sport.
words.example_cn: 他得现实地看待自己在这项运动上能走多远。

words.meaning_cn: 职业运动员;专业人士;职业的
words.example_en: The top competitors are professionals who train several hours a day.
words.example_cn: 顶尖选手都是每天训练数小时的职业运动员。

words.example_en: The team won the title for the third year in a row.
words.example_cn: 这支球队连续第三年夺得冠军。

words.example_en: Every great athlete knows that hard training comes before success.
words.example_cn: 每位伟大的运动员都明白,刻苦训练先于成功。

words.example_en: Her dream is to take part in the Olympic Games one day.
words.example_cn: 她的梦想是有一天能参加奥运会。

words.example_en: The spectators held their breath as the final point was played.
words.example_cn: 决胜分上演时,观众们都屏住了呼吸。

words.example_en: After years of training, she became the world champion in her event.
words.example_cn: 经过多年训练,她成为本项目的世界冠军。

words.example_en: Working together, the players led their team to a great victory.
words.example_cn: 通过齐心协力,球员们带领球队取得了大胜。

words.example_en: The goalkeeper bravely defended the goal until the final whistle.
words.example_cn: 门将一直勇敢地守卫球门,直到终场哨响。

words.example_en: She scored the winning point and the crowd went wild.
words.example_cn: 她拿下制胜的一分,观众都疯狂了。

words.example_en: He passed the ball forward into space for his teammate to run onto.
words.example_cn: 他把球向前传到空当,让队友插上接应。

words.example_en: The striker is preparing to shoot at the goal from outside the box.
words.example_cn: 前锋正准备在禁区外起脚射门。

words.example_en: It was a close match, and neither team scored until the very end.
words.example_cn: 这是场势均力敌的比赛,直到最后双方才有进球。

words.example_en: She made a superhuman effort and ran towards the ball.
words.example_cn: 她用尽全力,朝着球冲了过去。

words.example_en: Before the penalty, Tina looked very nervous indeed.
words.example_cn: 在罚点球之前,蒂娜看上去确实非常紧张。

words.example_en: Behind her she could hear the girls yelling encouragement.
words.example_cn: 她身后能听见女孩们大声喊着为她鼓劲。

words.example_en: The coach gave the players a quick pep talk before the penalties.
words.example_cn: 罚点球前,教练给球员们做了简短的动员。

words.example_en: Loyal fans stayed in the rain to support their favourite team.
words.example_cn: 忠实的球迷冒雨留下来支持自己喜爱的球队。

words.meaning_cn: 筋疲力尽的;疲惫不堪的
words.example_en: By the end of the match every player was completely exhausted.
words.example_cn: 比赛结束时每名球员都筋疲力尽。

words.example_en: He practised every day to improve his basketball skills.
words.example_cn: 他每天练习以提高自己的篮球技巧。

words.example_en: Having trained hard all winter, the team was ready for the season.
words.example_cn: 整个冬天刻苦训练之后,球队为新赛季做好了准备。

words.example_en: The referee blew the whistle to start the second half.
words.example_cn: 裁判吹哨开始下半场比赛。

words.example_en: The players ran together to celebrate the late winning goal.
words.example_cn: 球员们一起奔跑,庆祝那粒压哨制胜球。

words.example_en: Thousands of spectators came to support their home team.
words.example_cn: 成千上万的观众前来支持主队。
